alt: A short film with no voice, with music. An entryway with a door on the right . Two small block figures with white eyes, an ink-black one on the left and a royal blue one next to it. The black one says I'll wait here and the blue one says two minutes! and walks through the door, which opens and closes. The black one waits with narrowed eyes and a small shiver for a few seconds. The door opens, the blue one returns and says sorry! and the black one answers no rush with happy eyes and a pulse. Both end exactly where they started, so the loop is seamless. The text stays: me waiting while they run in for one thing.
comentario_fijado: A small friction, chosen on purpose.
